_: ETK RADIO service config. provision_etk_cloud_ai.sh writes /etc/etk-radio/config.json from this file with the node's home directory filled in. Keys starting with _ are comments; ANY OTHER unknown key is a hard error, because a typo'd retention_days that silently kept its default would delete nothing for thirty days before anyone noticed.
_bind: loopback only. Caddy is the only thing in front of this service; ss -ltn must never show 0.0.0.0:8737.
_ollama: Ollama is pinned to 127.0.0.1 by the systemd drop-in and is never exposed. keep_alive holds the weights (and the prefix-cached doctrine) between calls; spec 5 measured 82-118 tok/s warm against 17.9 cold on the 9b.
_state: ~ is expanded against the service user's home (the unit runs as ubuntu).
_budget: spec 6 never-truncate: the prompt is counted before the call and a job that would not fit num_ctx - num_predict - budget_slack is FAILED, not truncated.
_timeouts: chat_timeout_s has to cover a cold 9b weight load (91 s) plus a long prefill; ask_timeout_s is the spec 9 synchronous bound on /v1/ask.
_corpus: git pull before each debrief keeps corpus_commit honest (spec 4); a pull failure uses the checkout as it is.
_rules_only: true = skip the model stage entirely and answer from rules_only.build. The eval baseline, and the honest fallback while a rung is unproven (spec 10.3).
